title: Aqara Door Sensor Overnight Open Alert
app: Aqara, IKEA Tradfri, LIFX, Nanoleaf, Shelly, Zigbee2MQTT, Ecobee, and smart blind motors via vendor clouds, LAN APIs, MQTT bridges, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=aqara:device device_class=contact state=open
| eval hour=tonumber(strftime(_time,"%H"))
| where hour>=23 OR hour<5
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as overnight_opens by device _time
| where overnight_opens>0
| sort - overnight_opens
description: Uses Aqara door-contact events telemetry to monitor door openings during overnight quiet hours in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for unexpected night access or forgotten doors, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Aqara door-contact events data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It blends door openings during overnight quiet hours so you can spot unexpected night access or forgotten doors before it becomes annoying.
